subject.title: [codex] prefer terminal reply fields in CLI JSONL parser

question: After rebasing this PR, should OpenClaw adopt `task_complete.last_agent_message` then `final_answer` as the cross-dialect non-Claude CLI JSONL reply-precedence contract?
rationale: The supplied proof supports the desired Codex case, but selecting a permanent precedence rule across existing CLI JSONL dialects is a maintainer-facing compatibility decision and the branch currently conflicts with current main.

options.title: Adopt and rebase
options.body: Keep the terminal-field precedence, resolve conflicts against current main, and retain focused coverage for full-buffer and streaming parsing.

options.title: Narrow to a dialect
options.body: Apply the precedence only where the current Codex/OpenAI JSONL contract proves those terminal fields are authoritative.

options.title: Decline the contract
options.body: Keep the current generic fallback behavior if maintainers do not want parser-level terminal-field precedence across dialects.

recommendation.title: Adopt and rebase
recommendation.body: Keep the terminal-field precedence, resolve conflicts against current main, and retain focused coverage for full-buffer and streaming parsing.
